# openwrt_network_bridge_vlan (Resource)

A VLAN on a VLAN-filtering bridge (`config bridge-vlan`).

Manages a `bridge-vlan` section in `/etc/config/network`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) Bridge device name. (UCI option `device`.)
- `section` (String) UCI section name. Changing it renames the section in place.
- `vlan` (Number) VLAN ID. (UCI option `vlan`.)

### Optional

- `extra_lists` (Map of List of String) Additional list options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `extra_options` (Map of String) Additional scalar options not covered by this resource's attributes. Only listed keys are managed.
- `local` (Boolean) Also add the VLAN to the bridge itself. (UCI option `local`.)
- `ports` (List of String) Member ports, optionally suffixed `:t`, `:u`, `:*`. (UCI option `ports`.)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<config>.<section>`.
